ai_summary: ESAB India Limited held its 39th Annual General Meeting, where a significant final dividend of Rs. 25/- per equity share (250%) was proposed for shareholders, and Mr. Curtis Evan Jewell was formally introduced as the new Chairman of the Board. Key agenda items also included the adoption of FY2025-26 financial statements and director appointments, with the official voting results to be submitted separately. This signals a material return to shareholders and a notable leadership transition, with no immediate red flags identified beyond the pending disclosure of final voting outcomes.
